# Design principles and craft-feedback library

> **TL;DR:** Reusable rules and their enforcement states. Historical evidence identifiers are retained for traceability, but the private production history and customer sources are not distributed.

Rule base v1.0: 46 rules. Numeric thresholds remain uncalibrated; see docs/gaps-and-limitations.md.

## Design principles

### R-DEN-001 — One primary message per frame: introduce entities progressively on their spoken cue; avoid dense node graphs, simultaneous animations, tiny labels and excess connectors.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check (density)`; rubric dimensions LEG-DENSITY, CRE-ONE-MESSAGE
  - **Never:** Show the whole system at once
  - **Never:** Animate several groups simultaneously
  - **Always:** Reveal one idea per spoken cue
- **Evidence:** R03-v01, R04-v01, R06-e2e-v04, R07-v10, R07-v11, wei:M6, wei:M7.P1, wei:M7.P2
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye. The 8-text-elements cap is a first estimate.

### R-DES-001 — Bookends are minimal and iconic: bold caps type on the brand's primary field with white type, strong hierarchy, and the supplied partner logos on the opening and closing.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions DES-BOOKENDS
  - **Never:** Busy bookends with competing elements
  - **Never:** Small bookend text
  - **Never:** Logos missing from the opening or closing
  - **Always:** One title, one line, one lockup
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v04, R07-v01, wei:M5.2, wei:M6 — The brand colour itself is project-specific (design.md)
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-DES-003 — Logos and marks are the supplied files, scaled uniformly; never regenerated, morphed or deformed.

- **Testable form:** tool `design:compliance`; rubric dimensions DES-LOGO
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v04, wei:M3
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-DES-004 — Borrow motion grammar, not a template's skin: no imported amber/paper/serif looks, invented demo counters or UI, or unapproved architecture edges.

- **Testable form:** tool `design:compliance (prohibited patterns)`; rubric dimensions DES-PROHIBITED
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v02, wei:M3
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Creative and narrative preferences

### R-NAR-001 — Frame the story as the platform helping the customer's experts solve their business problems (the customer is the protagonist).

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions NAR-PERSPECTIVE
  - **Never:** A feature tour without a business problem
  - **Always:** Name whose problem is solved and how
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v04, wei:M5.2
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-NAR-002 — The film is one connected story: every scene connects to the one before and after; nothing is introduced before the viewer is ready.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions NAR-CONNECTION, NAR-CLARITY
  - **Never:** A scene that repeats information without adding value
  - **Never:** A concept introduced before it is needed
  - **Always:** Name the outgoing and incoming anchor of every seam
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Craft-quality expectations

### R-AST-001 — Generated imagery names a specific subject, setting and detail tied to a beat; product UI is captured, never generated; logos are supplied.

- **Testable form:** tool `assets:check_plan`; rubric dimensions DES-SPECIFICITY, ACC-UI
- **Evidence:** R02-v02-candidates, R03-v01, wei:M9
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-MOT-001 — Explanatory illustrations become animation that clarifies the problem; a static plate with a pan is not an explanation.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions CRE-MOTION
  - **Never:** Use a still illustration with only a camera move for an explanatory beat
  - **Always:** Animate the causal elements in the order the narration names them
- **Evidence:** R03-v01, R06-e2e-v04, wei:M5.3, wei:M5.6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-ACC-004 — Real UI pixels stay untouched: veils, blurs and camera moves are verified by a pixel-integrity audit with negative controls, and never mirror or reveal cut-off content.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions ACC-UI
  - **Never:** A backdrop-filter veil over product UI
  - **Never:** Readable cut-off words at a veil edge
  - **Always:** Compare rendered product pixels with the capture
  - **Always:** Prove the audit can fail (negative controls)
- **Evidence:** R07-v03, R07-v05, R07-v06 — critic r07-v03 (mirrored product text), r07-v06 (audit needs negative controls)
- **Lifecycle:** validated (advisory)

### R-UI-001 — Camera crops land in empty gutters, never through product text.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions CRE-POLISH
  - **Never:** Crop through a label or a paragraph at the frame edge
  - **Always:** Choose zooms whose edges fall in layout gutters
- **Evidence:** R07-v10, R07-v13 — critic r07-v10 P3-3 and r07-v13 P3-A
- **Lifecycle:** validated (advisory)

### R-UI-002 — Focus rings and highlights hold ≥ 1 s and never rest mid-slide over a label.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check (rings)`; rubric dimensions LEG-RING
- **Evidence:** R07-v10, R07-v13 — critic r07-v10 P3-1 and r07-v13 P3-C
- **Lifecycle:** validated (advisory)

## Legibility and accessibility

### R-CAP-001 — Captions are speech-locked: never after the first spoken word; mid-sentence lead ≤ 0.20 s; sentence-first lead ≤ 0.45 s into cleared time; never clear &gt; 0.10 s before the last word.

- **Testable form:** tool `captions:sync`; rubric dimensions ACC-CAPTIONS
- **Evidence:** R07-v13, R07-v14, R07-v15, wei:M6 — r07-v13→v15 critic rounds
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-CAP-002 — Caption reading rate ≤ 20 characters/s and each cue ≥ 0.8 s.

- **Testable form:** tool `captions:sync`; rubric dimensions ACC-CAPTIONS
- **Evidence:** R07-v06, R07-v15, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-001 — Critical text is ≥ 22 px at 1080p.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; threshold 22 px; rubric dimensions LEG-SIZE
- **Evidence:** R03-v01, R07-v01, wei:M6, wei:M9
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-002 — Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 for large text), using only approved text/background pairs.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; threshold WCAG 1.4.3; rubric dimensions LEG-CONTRAST
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, R07-v15, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-003 — Every text is on screen at least max(1.0 s, 0.24 s × words).

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; rubric dimensions LEG-DWELL, PAC-READ
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v02, R07-v08, R07-v09, R07-v12, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-004 — Essential content stays inside the title-safe area (x 96–1824 at 1920 wide).

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; rubric dimensions LEG-SAFE
- **Evidence:** R07-v08, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-005 — Nothing essential sits in the caption band (below y 900) while captions are on.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; rubric dimensions LEG-SAFE
- **Evidence:** R07-v02, R07-v12, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-006 — No ghost text: de-emphasised text steps down to a solid grey token, never partial opacity.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; rubric dimensions LEG-GHOST
- **Evidence:** R07-v08, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-LEG-007 — No more than 3 flashes in any second; colour is never the only carrier of meaning.

- **Testable form:** tool `legibility:check`; rubric dimensions LEG-FLASH, LEG-COLOR-CUE
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Visual consistency and detail

### R-DES-002 — Typography is one system: section titles, infographics and the bookends share the same families in defined roles.

- **Testable form:** tool `design:compliance`; rubric dimensions DES-TYPE, DES-CONSISTENCY
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v04, wei:M5.4, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-DES-005 — Every drawn colour and font traces to design.md tokens (the design-compliance trace replaces 'it doesn't follow design.md').

- **Testable form:** tool `design:compliance`; rubric dimensions DES-TOKENS
- **Evidence:** R07-v10, wei:M9
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Voice, sound, tone, pacing and transitions

### R-VOI-001 — The narrator is an adult tech professional with a warm, confident storytelling read; never a child-like or youthful voice.

- **Testable form:** a named human decides; rubric dimensions VOI-ADULT
  - **Never:** Ship a take a listener could describe as child-like, cartoonish or youthful
  - **Always:** Record age=adult and the delivery in voice-direction.json
  - **Always:** Request Wei's listening sign-off
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v03, R06-e2e-v04, wei:M5.1, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-VOI-002 — No stutter, dropped word, clipped ending or seam: every script unit is spoken in order, and mixing never attenuates inside speech by more than a 6 dB breath dip.

- **Testable form:** tool `audio:check_voice`; threshold max_speech_dip_db 6; rubric dimensions VOI-COMPLETE
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, R07-v07, wei:M6, wei:M7.P5
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-VOI-003 — Pronunciation is verified per product term; if a term is misheard in most takes, rephrase the line instead of shipping the error.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions VOI-PRONUNCIATION
  - **Never:** Keep a product term that ASR mishears in most takes
  - **Always:** List product terms and their expected pronunciation in voice-direction.json
- **Evidence:** R07-v08, wei:M6 — R07: 'versioned' heard as 'version' in 8/8 takes → rephrased
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-AUD-001 — Deliver at −16 LUFS integrated (±1) with true peak ≤ −1 dBTP, measured on the encoded master.

- **Testable form:** tool `media:technical_qa`; threshold -16 LUFS ±1; TP ≤ -1 dBTP; rubric dimensions TEC-LOUDNESS
- **Evidence:** R07-v07, R07-v15, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-AUD-002 — Music supports the voice: look-ahead ducking under speech, no competing phrases, no abrupt cuts; voice over music p10 ≥ 16 LU.

- **Testable form:** a named human decides; rubric dimensions CRE-MUSIC
  - **Never:** Let music phrases compete with narration
  - **Never:** Cut music abruptly at a seam
  - **Always:** Duck under speech
  - **Always:** Test several directions before choosing
- **Evidence:** R07-v07, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-AUD-003 — Every silence longer than 1.5 s is a planned pause; unexplained silence is a defect.

- **Testable form:** tool `media:technical_qa`; rubric dimensions TEC-SILENCE
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced) — Requirement approved by Wei; the numeric threshold was validated on Round 07 audits and the critic, not yet calibrated against Wei's own eye.

### R-MOT-002 — Motion and transitions serve comprehension: one brand-derived vocabulary, motivated seams (line-carry, matched frames), no decorative or repetitive transitions.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions CRE-TRANSITIONS, NAR-CONNECTION
  - **Never:** A transition that doesn't advance the story
  - **Never:** A new effect on every cut
  - **Always:** One transition per seam, specified in the storyboard
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v02, R06-e2e-v07, wei:M3, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Storytelling and product demonstrations

### R-ACC-001 — The engineers' terminology is the source of truth: never invent a term, and map requested terms that have no source instead of adopting them.

- **Testable form:** tool `accuracy:check_script`; rubric dimensions ACC-TERMS, ACC-CLAIMS
- **Evidence:** R03-v01, R07-v10, wei:M7.P3
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-ACC-002 — No invented UI, metrics, counters, claims or architecture edges; the prototype is shown untouched, with boundary tags where the demo is synthetic or target-state.

- **Testable form:** tool `accuracy:check_film`; rubric dimensions ACC-UI, ACC-BOUNDARIES
- **Evidence:** R01-v01, R02-v02-master, R03-v01, R05-pass-02, wei:M3
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-ACC-003 — Demonstrate the real workflow in depth: open the detail pages (signal → evidence → case → plan → governance steps), never stopping on a list.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions ACC-DEPTH
  - **Never:** End the walkthrough on a list view
  - **Never:** Describe a feature without showing it
  - **Always:** Show the detail page and the decision it supports
- **Evidence:** R02-v02-candidates, R06-e2e-v04, R07-v10, wei:M5.5, wei:M7.P4
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-UI-003 — Direct attention to real UI with highlight rings on measured boxes and restrained camera moves (video-shotcraft), so the viewer knows where to look.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases; rubric dimensions CRE-FOCUS
  - **Never:** Show a full screen with no focus cue
  - **Always:** Ring the element the narration names
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v04, wei:M5.5
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Recurring failure patterns

### R-PRO-002 — Machine QA and critic READY are never human approval: human listening, taste and release are separate named decisions, and dry-run approvals are labelled not human.

- **Testable form:** tool `engine:decide`
- **Evidence:** R01-v01, R02-v02-candidates, R05-pass-02, R06-e2e-v07, R07-v07, R07-v15 — R01 quality contract: technical_pass_is_visual_pass=false; human_release_approval_required=true
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-007 — Every version is reviewed on its own rendered evidence by an independent critic through the project's review lenses; an earlier READY never survives new rejection.

- **Testable form:** tool `evaluation:gate (reviews must be current-version)`; rubric dimensions CRE-LENSES
- **Evidence:** R06-e2e-v01, R06-e2e-v03, R06-e2e-v04, R06-e2e-v05, R06-e2e-v06, R07-v04, wei:M6 — R07-v04 was a self-audited intermediate with no critic row
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Effective corrective actions

### R-PRO-003 — Freeze and hash the source evidence before rendering; if sources drift, re-render from the frozen sources instead of weakening the test.

- **Testable form:** tool `engine:_integrity_problems`
- **Evidence:** R02-v02-candidates, R04-v01 — R02: rerendered after source-lineage drift
- **Lifecycle:** validated (advisory)

### R-PRO-008 — Scope each rework to the exact critic findings and re-run only what they trace to; never restart broadly.

- **Testable form:** tool `regen:plan`
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, R07-v02, R07-v05, R07-v13, R07-v14 — Round 07 critic loop
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-009 — Resume from durable project state (state, checkpoints, ledger, repo files), never from a long chat history; preserve the original session.

- **Testable form:** tool `engine:_resume_fixups`
- **Evidence:** R04-v01-recovery-finish, wei:M1 — R04: the renderer and session crashed; the work was resumed from repo files
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-010 — A correction must produce fresh evidence: a defect resolves only when its reviewer re-runs on a newer version and no longer reports it; a fix that changes nothing counts as a failed attempt.

- **Testable form:** tool `evaluation:compare_after_rework`
- **Evidence:** task:vpg-dry-run-2026-09-26 — found by vpg's own dry run: an unchanged script 'fix' passed the gate before this rule
- **Lifecycle:** candidate (inactive)

## Production practices that are defaults

### R-PRO-001 — Never stop after one production round: keep the produce→critique→fix loop running until every gate passes or a genuine blocker is reported.

- **Testable form:** tool `engine:review_gate`
- **Evidence:** R05-pass-01, R06-e2e-v04, R07-v10, wei:M2, wei:M5.7 — Wei: 'you should not stop when you just finish one round of production'
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-004 — Prove a change on one 10–15 s clip with real assets before batching it across the film.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases
  - **Never:** Batch a new look, voice or motion rule across every chapter before a single-clip proof
  - **Always:** Render a 10–15 s actual-asset proof and review it first
- **Evidence:** R01-v02-scene01, wei:M3 — R01 scene01 proof; Wei's shotcraft handoff: 'the next proof is a 10–15 s continuity/voice test, not a restart'
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-005 — Preserve every rejected version with its failure evidence; replace a strong element only when the new one is demonstrably better.

- **Testable form:** tool `engine:_commit_outputs (superseded, never deleted)`
- **Evidence:** R04-v01, R05-pass-01, wei:M6 — R04/R05 lessons
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

### R-PRO-006 — The runtime cap is a hard constraint: cut words and holds, never evidence the viewer needs, and never speed up the voice.

- **Testable form:** tool `pacing:estimate_script`; threshold brief.runtime_max_s; rubric dimensions PAC-RUNTIME, TEC-DURATION
- **Evidence:** R05-pass-01, R05-pass-02, wei:M2, wei:M4
- **Lifecycle:** adopted (enforced)

## Decisions that must remain project-specific

### R-PS-001 — Case 2026-09: remove 'Governance at every step' (redundant); show governance concretely instead.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases
  - **Never:** Use the phrase in narration or on screen
- **Evidence:** R07-v08, wei:M7.P6
- **Lifecycle:** approved (advisory)

### R-PS-002 — Case 2026-09: the customer's brand-colour field with white bold caps; the partner lockup on both bookends.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases
  - **Always:** Use the approved lockup files
- **Evidence:** R07-v01, wei:M6
- **Lifecycle:** approved (advisory)

### R-PS-003 — Case 2026-09 review lenses: customer executive, operations leader, sustainability leader, engineer, first-time viewer.

- **Testable form:** reviewer cases
  - **Always:** Score every lens
- **Evidence:** R07-v10, wei:M7
- **Lifecycle:** approved (advisory)

## Historical evidence

The original case study is private. Evidence identifiers are historical references, not public verification claims. Establish your own calibration and human approvals before adopting these defaults.
